t: This is the Deutsche Evangelische Christuskirche, the German Evangelical church, on Montpelier Place in Knightsbridge. The German theologian Julius Rieger described it as the most significant German church in London, which tells you how much it has meant to the German community here. It was designed by Edward Boehmer, an American-born architect who was based in London. He lived from 1861 to 1940.
